culpritSource.quote: Conan realizes that the culprit must've interfered with the rigor mortis and finds the evidence to convict the culprit. The culprit is Minoru Kijima, who was romantically involved with the victim. After confessing to his girlfriend's murder, Minoru posthumously revealed Umeda as a villainous blackmailer. As a result of their relationship, Umeda gave Minoru benefits regarding their work, a gesture Minoru was happy with. But when Minoru began trying to pursue another relationship, the evil Umeda threatened to destroy her boyfriend's career if he broke up with her, driving Minoru to kill Umeda to

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan are checking out costumes for Kogoro's one day of being a chief firemen. Later they meet people attending a costume party. While walking home, they find a police car in front of the house and meet the people from the costume shop earlier, realizing the host has been murdered.

suspects: Minoru Kijima, Jiro Ishikawa, Yoko Nakamura, and Masatake Shimizu
